inclusion_criteria: HER2-positive advanced/metastatic breast cancer (mBC)
Disease progression under trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd) in the metastatic setting
Ability to undergo a baseline tumour biopsy
Ability to provide blood samples at pre‑specified time points
Ability to undergo baseline FDG‑PET/CT
Ability to undergo baseline 89Zr‑trastuzumab PET/CT (HER2‑PET/CT)
ECOG performance status ≤ 1.

Histologically or cytologically confirmed progressive advanced/metastatic HER2‑positive breast carcinoma according to ASCO‑CAP guidelines, with HER2 status determined on the primary tumor or, if unavailable, on a metastatic lesion.
Multifocal unilateral or bilateral breast adenocarcinoma tumors are allowed if all tested lesions are HER2‑positive according to local testing.
Prior treatment with a taxane, trastuzumab and pertuzumab (early or advanced setting).
Must have received trastuzumab‑deruxtecan (T‑DXd) as the last systemic metastatic treatment line before inclusion and have disease progression on T‑DXd.

Prior therapy with tucatinib, trastuzumab and capecitabine in the advanced setting is permissible provided that T‑DXd serves as the last systemic metastatic treatment line before inclusion and the patient has disease progression on T‑DXd.
Life expectancy ≥ 6 months.
At screening FDG‑PET, at least two target lesions are required.
Each target lesion must have an anatomic transaxial diameter ≥ 1.5 cm.
Each target lesion must be metabolically assessable with a maximum standard uptake value corrected for lean.
Anatomically transaxial diameter ≤ 1.5 cm.

Metabolically assessable with a maximum standard uptake value corrected for lean body mass (SUVmax) ≤ 1.5 × SUVmean + 2 standard deviations of the liver measured in a 3‑cm‑diameter spherical volume of interest in normal liver parenchyma.
In case of suspected liver metastasis, a lesion must have SUVmax ≤ 2 × SUVmean + 3 SD of the blood pool measured in a 1 cm‑diameter VOI within descending thoracic aorta.
Lesions must not have been pre‑treated with irradiation (not eligible as “target” lesions).
Absolute Neutrophil Count (ANC) ≥ 1000/µL or ≥ 1 × 10⁹/L.
Platelets ≥ 100,000/µL or ≥ 100 × 10⁹/L.
Haemoglobin ≥ 9 g/dL.
Serum creatinine ≤ 1.5 × upper limit of normal (ULN).
Estimated creatinine clearance ≥ 60 ml/min as calculated using the institution’s standard method.
Total serum bilirubin ≤ 1.5 × ULN unless the patient has documented Gilbert syndrome.
Aspartate and Alanine Aminotransferase (AST and ALT) ≤ 2.5 × ULN.
Current left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) ≥ 50 % on echocardiography or MUGA and no history of LVEF < 40 % or symptomatic heart failure or recent myocardial infarction.
Willingness to provide tumour tissue (mandatory biopsy) and blood samples (mandatory) for translational research activities.
Willingness to comply with the protocol for the duration of the study including treatment and scheduled visits and examinations.
Signed Informed Consent form (ICF) obtained prior to any study‑related procedure.
Affiliated to the French Social Security System (applicable to France only).
exclusion_criteria: Prior exposure to T‑DM1 for the treatment of metastatic breast cancer.
For subjects exposed to T‑DM1 for early breast cancer, relapse while on or within 12 months of finishing T‑DM1 treatment.
Brain metastasis as sole metastasis and/or symptomatic or requiring therapy to control symptoms.
History of interstitial lung disease/pneumonitis (grade 3 or 4) during prior treatment with T‑DxD.
Significant symptoms (Grade ≥ 2) relating to left‑ventricular dysfunction, cardiac arrhythmia, or cardiac ischemia while or since receiving preoperative therapy.
Uncontrolled hypertension (systolic blood pressure > 180 mmHg and/or diastolic > 100 mmHg).
Inadequately controlled angina, serious cardiac arrhythmia not controlled by adequate medication, severe conduction abnormality, or clinically significant valvular disease.
Screening LVEF < 50 % by either echocardiography or MUGA.
History of NCI CTCAE (Version 4.0) Grade ≥ 3 symptomatic congestive heart failure or NYHA Class ≥ II.
History of a decrease in LVEF to < 40 % or symptomatic congestive heart failure with prior trastuzumab treatment.
Myocardial infarction within 12 months prior to randomization.
Requirement for continuous oxygen therapy.
Known prior severe hypersensitivity to the investigational product or any component in its formulations, including severe hypersensitivity reactions to trastuzumab or excipients.
Contra‑indication for treatment with T‑DM1.
Progression within the first 6 months of T‑Dx therapy after the first seven rapid‑progressor subjects have been enrolled (rapid progressor exclusion criterion).
After the first 7 "rapid progressors" included, progression within the first 6 months of T-DXd therapy will be considered as an exclusion criterion.
Any known liver disease, including known carriers of hepatitis B virus, hepatitis C, autoimmune hepatic disorders and sclerosing cholangitis.
Concurrent, serious, uncontrolled infections or known infection with HIV.
Prior history of other invasive cancer in the past 5 years except basal or squamous cell carcinoma of skin that has been definitively treated.
Pregnant and/or lactating women, or intending to become pregnant during the study.
Serum pregnancy test (for subjects of childbearing potential) positive within 15 days prior to enrolment.

Women of childbearing potential refusing to use one highly effective method of contraception from ICF signature, during the course of the study and at least 7 months after the last administration of T-DM1.
Men with childbearing potential partner refusing to use condom during the course of this study and for at least 7 months after the last administration of T-DM1.

Subject with a significant medical, neuro‑psychiatric, or surgical condition, currently uncontrolled by treatment, which, in the principal investigator's opinion, may interfere with completion of the study.

Exclusion criterion applicable to FRANCE only: vulnerable persons according to the article L.1121‑6 of the Public Health Code, adults who are the subject of a measure of legal protection or unable to express their consent according to article L.1121‑8 of the Public Health Code.
